We're proud to share that 35+ members of the ThoughtSpot team came together to be part of this school beautification initiative, bringing colour and care to the school's walls.

Being part of this experience meant a great deal to us, and we're thankful for the opportunity to contribute to a space where children learn and grow.

They came to colour a school's walls. Somewhere between the first brushstroke and the last, they found their own inner child again.

Grateful to the @thoughtspot volunteers who showed up with full hearts and paint-covered hands.

Turns out some "work days" don't feel like work at all.

Today the world remembers the environment. We never forgot.

Marpu doesn't live for one green day a year. Every day, every hour, our volunteers choose the planet first.

They ask for nothing back, and that is exactly what makes them the gift this earth keeps unwrapping.

The environment doesn't need a date on the calendar. It needs people who stayed.

🌱

Light for a Sustainable Future.

A reminder that 2026 is also the International Year of Volunteers for
Sustainable Development.

Both ideas anchor the same truth. Communities don't change because of
funding alone. They change because of the people who show up,
year after year, with curiosity and care.

Marpu Foundation. 23+ states. 250+ corporate partners. Over a million
volunteers and counting.

This isn't a CSR checkbox. It's what it looks like when companies actually show up.

Every frame is an employee. Engineers planting trees. Analysts painting classrooms. Managers reviving wetlands. Coders assembling solar lamps for kids who'd never had study light.
250+ corporate partners. A million people who decided their workday belonged to something larger.

Marpu doesn't run CSR drives. We run the kind your team will still talk about in the Monday standup.

Want yours in the next reel? Let's talk →

Every breath matters clean air is essential for a healthy life.

This World Asthma Day, let’s raise awareness about how pollution affects respiratory health.

A cleaner environment means fewer struggles for those living with asthma.

Small actions like reducing pollution and planting trees can create lasting impact.

Join Marpu Foundation in building a future where everyone can breathe freely. 🌿

Seed balls are one of the simplest reforestation tools, and one of the oldest.

What is a seed ball?

→ A small ball of clay, compost, and native seeds
→ Scattered across degraded land
→ Breaks open with the first rain, and the seedling grows

Why does it work?

→ Native seeds match the local ecosystem
→ The clay shell protects from birds, ants, and harsh sun
→ The compost feeds the seedling through its first weeks
→ Reaches land that conventional plantation cannot

Why does it count under CSR?

→ Aligned with Schedule VII activity 4: environmental sustainability and conservation of natural resources
→ Feeds directly into BRSR Core biodiversity disclosure
→ Hands-on, trackable, and CSR-2 documentation ready

Aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals:

→ SDG 13: Climate Action
→ SDG 15: Life on Land
→ SDG 17: Partnerships for the Goals

To organise a seed ball session for your team, school, or community, write to connect@marpu.org or visit

One book can spark a question. 
One question can start a journey. 
One journey can change a generation.

In underserved schools across India, children sit in classrooms with no books, no libraries, no windows to the world beyond their walls.

A single book can open that window.
This World Book Day, let's bring the gift of reading to those who need it most.

The biggest challenges of our time climate change, poverty, gender inequality won't be solved by bigger CSR budgets. They'll be solved by better questions.

At Marpu Foundation, one of India's largest volunteer-led NGOs across 23+ states with 250+ corporate CSR partners, social innovation starts with the people closest to the problem.



The programmes that last aren't the most expensive they're the ones built with communities, not just for them.

That's the creativity this UN observance calls for. That's the innovation sustainable development demands.

owner_posts.post_text:
Creating Positive Change Through Education & Community Development 

At Light of Life Trust, we are dedicated to supporting education, women empowerment, healthcare, and sustainable community development initiatives across India. Our mission is to help individuals and communities build a brighter future through meaningful programs and opportunities.

Whether you're looking to support an NGO in Mumbai, volunteer, or contribute to educational initiatives, every small effort can make a difference.

Medical Mobile Unit – Bringing Healthcare to Your Community

At Light of Life Trust, our Medical Mobile Unit brings essential healthcare services directly to communities in need. We understand that access to quality medical care isn’t always easy, especially for underserved populations. That’s why our mobile unit travels to neighbourhoods, villages, and outreach areas to provide compassionate, reliable health services where they’re needed most.

If you’re looking for reliable, compassionate Medical Mobile Unit services for your community or organization, Light of Life Trust is here to help. Together, we can make healthcare more accessible and equitable for all.

Learn more about our Mobile Healthcare Services.

Anando School Empowerment Programme

The Anando School Empowerment Programme by Light of Life Trust is dedicated to uplifting and empowering students across communities. Our programme focuses on holistic development, providing children with access to quality education, life skills, and mentorship opportunities that foster confidence, creativity, and personal growth.

Through interactive workshops, skill-building activities, and continuous guidance, we help students realise their full potential and prepare them for a brighter future. 

Learn more about the Anando School Empowerment Programme and support the growth and empowerment of young minds today!

Environment Conservation Programme for a Greener Tomorrow

The Environment Conservation Programme by Light of Life Trust is dedicated to creating a greener, more sustainable future through community-driven initiatives. By focusing on environmental awareness, tree plantation, and sustainable practices, the program empowers individuals and communities to take meaningful steps toward protecting natural resources.

Through education and active participation, the initiative encourages responsible habits that contribute to long-term ecological balance. From rural outreach to hands-on activities, every effort is designed to make a lasting impact on both people and the environment.

Be a part of positive change. Join the Environment Conservation Programme today and help build a cleaner, healthier future for generations to come.

Donate Today – Support Education & Empower Lives with Light of Life Trust

Looking to donate and make a real difference? Light of Life Trust helps transform the lives of underprivileged children and communities across India through education, career guidance, and skill development. Your contribution directly supports programs that empower young girls and students to break the cycle of poverty and build brighter futures. Whether you give once or choose ongoing support, every donation helps create lasting change. Join us in making education accessible and meaningful—donate today and be part of a powerful journey of hope and opportunity.

Your support can help a child access education and a brighter future. Make your donation today!

Best NGO in Mumbai Supporting Communities with Care

As the best NGO in Mumbai, we are dedicated to creating meaningful change by supporting communities in need through education, healthcare, and social welfare initiatives. Our mission is to uplift underprivileged individuals and provide opportunities that help them build a better future. With a compassionate approach and strong community involvement, we work tirelessly to make a positive impact.

Recognised as a best NGO in Mumbai, our organisation focuses on empowering people, spreading awareness, and encouraging social responsibility. Through various programmes and volunteer support, we strive to bring hope, dignity, and long-term improvement to the lives of those who need it the most.

Anando Plus Programme | Light of Life Trust

The Anando Plus Programme by Light of Life Trust is a meaningful initiative designed to support the education and overall development of underprivileged children in India. Through this program, students receive guidance, learning resources, and mentorship that help them stay in school and build a brighter future. The Anando Plus Programme focuses not only on academic growth but also on life skills, confidence building, and personal development. With the support of dedicated mentors and community partners, the program empowers children to overcome challenges and pursue their dreams with hope and determination.

Building a Greener Tomorrow with Our Environment Conservation Programme

The Environment Conservation Programme by Light of Life Trust is dedicated to promoting sustainable living and environmental awareness. Through community engagement, educational workshops, and green initiatives, we encourage individuals to understand the importance of protecting natural resources. Our goal is to inspire responsible habits that support a cleaner and healthier environment for future generations. By working with students, communities, and volunteers, we continue to create meaningful environmental impact and awareness.

Join our Environment Conservation Programme and be part of the change today!

Best NGO in Mumbai | Supporting Education & Community Welfare

Light of Life Trust is recognised as one of the best NGO in Mumbai, dedicated to empowering underprivileged communities through education, skill development, and sustainable livelihood programmes. Our mission is to create opportunities for children and youth from disadvantaged backgrounds so they can build a brighter and more independent future.

Through various initiatives, we support education, mentorship, and career guidance for students who need it the most. Our dedicated team and volunteers work closely with communities to bring long-term positive change and promote social development.

Learn more today!

Build Skills for a Better Future with Our Livelihood Training Programme

Empower your future with the Livelihood Training Programme at Light of Life Trust. Our programme is designed to help individuals build practical skills, boost confidence, and create real opportunities for sustainable employment and self-reliance. Whether you’re learning vocational skills, mastering digital tools, or gaining hands-on experience, our supportive trainers are with you every step of the way. We focus on real-world learning, personal growth, and strong community support so every participant can unlock their potential. owner_posts.post_text:
Team Mauritius 2026 stands with the Mauritian flag, with Le Morne as our witness.

We are a team of young Mauritian students and mentors preparing to represent Mauritius at the FIRST Global Challenge 2026 in Incheon, Republic of Korea.

Our mission is to learn, build, collaborate and show that a small island can carry a big vision. This journey is about robotics, yes, but also responsibility, courage, discipline and interdependence.

We stand for Mauritius. We stand for youth innovation. We stand ready to learn with the world.

A robot is built twice: first in the mind, then by hand.

This week, Team Mauritius 2026 moved closer to completing its drivetrain, carefully testing alignment, movement and function.

Every screw tightened and every component adjusted is teaching our students something deeper: discipline creates confidence.

Next comes programming, where their ideas will begin to control motion.

This is what progress looks like before the applause.

Team Mauritius 2026 has made strong progress this week and is nearing completion of the robot drivetrain.

The students have been assembling, adjusting and testing each component with care, learning that engineering is not only about parts, but patience, focus and trust.

They are now entering the programming phase, where the robot will begin to move from idea to action.

Their team of experts is dedicated, caring, and truly committed to making a difference. I'm impressed by their comprehensive approach, from diagnosis to treatment and support. Their efforts are giving children a brighter future, and that's something to be proud of! 🌟👓💡 Keep up the fantastic work! 🙏"

Kudos to the entire team for their tireless efforts in helping children see the world with clarity and confidence! 🙏🌟👓"

featured_reviews.name: Rima paul
featured_reviews.review_text: We've been in orphanage on occasion, truly appreciative of few youngsters who took initiative, efforts & dedication towards this children's education for making them not to feel lonely and bringing happiness on faces. Hoping for those children's bright future and wishing all the best to all youngsters for such wonderful initiative. FEELING SO HAPPY TO BE PART OF CAMPAIGN. Wishing you all the best and hoping people to join to contribute for those who are indeed.

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: A heartfelt thank you to child vision foundation for making my birthday truly special by spreading kindness and joy through your generous food donation. Your efforts brought smiles and warmth to many, and I couldn’t have asked for a better way to celebrate. Grateful beyond words!”

name: Association of Christian Thoughfulness
description:
We are an NGO established in 1973 working for the betterment of the poor and empowering the community so that they can become socially and economically independent.

Passion is the energy that keeps us going, that keeps us filled with meaning, and happiness, and excitement, and anticipation. Passion is a powerful force in accomplishing anything you set your mind to, and in experiencing work and life the fullest extent possible.

Ultimately, passion is the driving force behind success and happiness that allows us all to live better lives. At Association for Christian Thoughtfulness (ACT) we are passionate about people. This is the energy that drives us to make a difference in the lives of the poor and marginalized.
